# Fruit crate: an open box 0.8 x 0.55 x 0.45 m of light wood with a heap of apples on top. Static.
new
material new Wood --base-color 0.6549 0.4824 0.3569 --no-slot
material new Slat --base-color 0.5020 0.2863 0.2275 --no-slot
material new Apple --base-color 0.7059 0.3216 0.3216 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Box --size 1 --location 0 0 0.225
scale 0.8 0.55 0.45
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Band --size 1 --location 0 0 0.25
scale 0.84 0.59 0.1
apply --scale
material assign Slat
add mesh ico-sphere --name A0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.15 --location -0.2 -0.05 0.5
material assign Apple
add mesh ico-sphere --name A1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.15 --location 0.12 0.06 0.5
material assign Apple
add mesh ico-sphere --name A2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.15 --location -0.02 -0.08 0.62
material assign Apple
select all
active Box
join
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
shade flat
export crate.glb
